title: The First Trust Broken in Paradise
intro: Imagine standing in a garden of perfect peace, honored above all creation, with only one boundary to respect. A whisper promises eternity, a single choice changes everything, and yet mercy opens a way back. Who speaks from the beginning of humanity?
clues: I was created by Allah from clay and fashioned with divine care.
I was honored when Allah commanded the angels to prostrate to me.
I dwelled in Paradise with my spouse, free to enjoy all except one tree.
I was deceived by the whispering of Satan who swore to be a sincere advisor.
I ate from the forbidden tree and my covering was removed in shame.
I learned words of repentance from my Lord, and Allah turned to me in mercy.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Jalut (Goliath)
Dhul-Kifl
Namrud
Prophet Adam
Prophet Yahya

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Refused to enter the Holy Land out of fear
Demanded fire be worshipped as a god
Killed a brother out of envy over an offering
Ate from the forbidden tree after Satan's whispering
Argued that idols of ancestors must be worshipped
trial.answer: Ate from the forbidden tree after Satan's whispering

location.label: Key Element
options: The River Nile
The Ark
The Sacred Valley of Tuwa
Paradise (Jannah)
The Cave of Hira

outcome.label: Outcome
options: I was drowned in the great flood with the disbelievers
Allah taught me words of repentance and forgave me
I was struck with lightning for demanding to see Allah
I was swallowed by a great fish for leaving in anger
I was transformed with my people for breaking the Sabbath
outcome.answer: Allah taught me words of repentance and forgave me

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
